desc: Implement feasibility check for odd/even counts and return [] when impossible or k exceeds the total valid count.
Precompute capped factorials and define a completion-count helper based on remaining odd/even counts and required next parity.
Implement greedy lexicographic unranking by maintaining sorted available numbers, trying candidates in increasing order, subtracting counts, and updating parity/remaining counts.
Verify sample tests and edge cases (n=1, n=2, impossible parity counts, k out of range).
